schema.title: PROPOSED same-owner authored native host policy; software versions excluded

rules.expression: for resource cpuMillicores,memoryBytes,tasks: BigInt(system)+BigInt(kubernetes)+sum(BigInt(role)) <=9007199254740991; never round overflow

q=BigInt(pool.cpuMillicores)*BigInt(pool.cpuPeriodMicroseconds)/1000; product divisible by1000; q>=1000 and q<=9007199254740991; CFS period1000..1000000; currentcpuMillicores bound<=floor(MAX_SAFE/100) preserved until separately reviewed
rules.reject: NATIVE_NODE_CPU_QUOTA_RATE_INVALID (proposed producer semantic guard; existing Core/setup range diagnostics remain separate)

rules.expression: same physical node UID/machineId/bootId Ready; selected deployed containerd version equals sole versions.json selection; cgroupDriver systemd/cgroupsPerQOS/enforceNodeAllocatable pods; taskCapacity min(pidMax,threadsMax)>withheld and0<podTasksMax<=remaining; for CPU/memory capacity>withheld and0<allocatable<=capacity-withheld; host profile plus active scope reservations fit actual admission algorithm, not syntactic max alone
rules.reject: exact native-worker-node-capacity.mjs NATIVE_NODE_* and Core native pool readiness/limit mismatch diagnostics
